findings.message: 'acme_search' uses contrib module 'search_api' (class) without declaring it in acme_search.info.yml dependencies: it is only required in composer.json, so Drupal does not enable it when 'acme_search' is installed.
findings.suggestion: Add '- search_api:search_api' to dependencies: (verify the drupal.org project name).

findings.message: Submodule 'acme_search_ui' declares core_version_requirement: ^8.8 || ^9 || ^10, which does not admit Drupal 11: core marks it incompatible and it cannot be installed.
findings.suggestion: Set it to the parent's constraint ('^10.3'): /drupilot-port does this with set-core-requirement.sh.

findings.message: 'acme_search_ui' uses project module 'acme_core' (library) without declaring it in acme_search_ui.info.yml dependencies: installing 'acme_search_ui' alone fails or breaks at runtime.
